topic: Countries with the most time zones

sources.title: List of time zones by country

claims.text: France, with its overseas territories, has the most time zones: 12 (13 with its Antarctic claim).
claims.quote: France , including its overseas territories, has the most time zones with 12 (13 including its claim in Antarctica ); France has more time zones than any other country, at 12 worldwide

claims.text: Russia 11, United States 11, Australia 9, United Kingdom 9, Canada 5.
claims.quote: Russia 11; United States 11; Australia 9; United Kingdom 9; Canada 5
claims.label: incl. territories, excl. Antarctica

claims.text: China uses a single time zone (UTC+8) though it spans five geographical time zones.
claims.quote: The time in China follows a single standard time offset of UTC+08:00 , where Beijing is located, even though the country spans five geographical time zones

myths.myth: Russia has the most time zones.
myths.truth: Russia has 11; France has 12 counting its overseas territories.
